description: This file defines the SurfaceViewOverlay class, an Android activity demonstrating overlays on a SurfaceView including toggling view visibility with buttons.

classes.name: SurfaceViewOverlay
classes.description: An Activity demonstrating overlays and visibility control over Views on top of a SurfaceView.

classes.name: HideMeListener
classes.description: Inner class implementing OnClickListener to hide specific Views when clicked.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and wires up button click listeners.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles activity resume; currently just calls superclass. Ideally used for resuming game/graphics updates.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Handles activity pause; currently just calls superclass. Ideally used for pausing game/graphics updates.

methods.name: HideMeListener.<init>
methods.description: Constructor setting the target view to hide.

methods.name: mVisibleListener.onClick
methods.description: Makes victim views and container visible when clicked.

methods.name: mInvisibleListener.onClick
methods.description: Sets victim views and container to INVISIBLE when clicked.

methods.name: mGoneListener.onClick
methods.description: Sets victim views and container to GONE when clicked.
